summary: Verified all colour fidelity fixes + Smart Pairings + Quote-With-Colours on /visualiser. Uploaded synthetic house image, ran auto-detect (mask covers 90.2% of wall band, 1.3% sky, 0% ground — clean), painted with Warm ivory and Dark royal blue swatches, sampled ONLY pixels where the detect mask is fully opaque (alpha>=200) in the wall band (y 30-45%, excluding the door column). Result: colour fidelity is essentially perfect, well within tolerance. All 7 pairing rules render the exact curated trio specified. Quote link now embeds the chosen colours.

context_for_next_testing_agent: When measuring colour fidelity on /visualiser, ALWAYS restrict pixel samples to positions where the brush-canvas mask alpha >= 200. Without that filter, unpainted sky/ground pixels leak into the average and inflate the L spread misleadingly. The mask alpha lives on data-testid='colour-brush-canvas' at natural dimensions. Also, after clicking a pairing button, only the WOODWORK layer changes; the pairings list itself is driven by the WALLS colour, so re-read pairings only after changing the walls swatch.
